title: Four re-blessed strain captures across two demos and three ticks are byte-identical (same git blobs) before and after the re-bless
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/qos_contention/01000ms.png b/goldens/qos_contention/01000ms.png
index 3c26f46..0489869 100644
diff --git a/goldens/qos_contention/10000ms.png b/goldens/qos_contention/10000ms.png
index 3c26f46..0489869 100644
diff --git a/goldens/sla/01000ms.png b/goldens/sla/01000ms.png
index 3c26f46..0489869 100644
diff --git a/goldens/sla/04000ms.png b/goldens/sla/04000ms.png
index 3c26f46..0489869 100644
detail: All four files share identical old (3c26f46) and new (0489869) blobs, so sla 1s/4s and qos_contention 1s/10s renders are byte-identical at ticks 20/80/200; no per-capture strain or tick-derived pulse variation appears in the goldens.
recommended_fix: Confirm identical stills across captures are intended for goldens; if captures should encode strain magnitude or pulse phase (pinned 16-step table), re-render each capture individually.
